search.description: Search path used on the site (e.g., 'search?q=')

default.description: If true, this site is considered a default option.

alias.description: One or more aliases for the site.

delimiter.description: A character or string used to separate search terms.

resources.description: Resource definitions for specific parts of the site. Supports deep, nested structures.

SearchObject.description: Object describing search path for the site. Supports deep, nested structures.

main.description: Main search path for the site.

additionalProperties.description: Additional search path for the site.
